description: Margin builder from E030's implication. Translate 4 hurt more under Muon (-0.62 pp) than under SGD (-0.35 pp), so the weak-augmentation optimum may sit below 2 px under Muon. On tip E031, change only the random-translate amplitude, from 2 px to 1 px (reflect padding as now) in both resolution phases. Everything else is fixed.
